changeSet.comment: RDR-225 P3.3: drop nexus.chunks_retired_225 and nexus.taxonomy_centroids_retired_225 (the pre-walk tables vectors-030-1 kept), with their _retired_225 indexes and constraints. Logs each table's row count first (RAISE NOTICE); no CASCADE; lock_timeout 120s; an absent table is skipped. DATA EFFECT: irreversible, every row of nexus.chunks_retired_225 and nexus.taxonomy_centroids_retired_225 is deleted with the tables; the rollback recreates both EMPTY in the shape vectors-030-1 leaves. Cloud window: 14 days after the 2026-10-07 walk deploy. Local window: the time between the engine release carrying vectors-030-1 and the one carrying this changeset; zero when an install crosses both in one boot.
